parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that Hale cannot sign her up ('past me'). It does not claim it did or will, and it makes no promise to text later once sign-up becomes possible. The alternative it offers is allowed: watching a class page for an open spot, which the parent would have to ask for by sending the link. It is slightly less helpful than it could be, since it skips the calendar-reminder option that fits 'I keep forgetting.' 'Past me' is also a bit idiomatic.
